lines: 「Well, she is a god from another world, after all.」
「It would not be so bad if Lilith had reached the same level as her predecessor, but it's tricky for her as she is now.」
「Aww, hey, Berylic. That's inconsiderate to say. I'm trying my best too...」
I knew she was trying her best, but the might of the demon god Bastet was overwhelming.
It was the same as that time with Juno. This was absolutely not an opponent that human beings could compete with.
「Nyaaan! For some reason, more and more power's surging through me, nya!! This feels nice, nya!」
「My strength is several times what it was, nya～! I'm not afraid of anything anymore, nyaaa～～!」
「Fufun, my coat and claws are in perfect shape, nya! I'll let'cha see my power all ya want, nya!!」
The cat beastmen were also gaining more and more strength from Bastet's cat power.
「Kuh! These guys are no ordinary people, huh?! No, it's because I'm wearing these frilly clothes!」
「This is useless! It's too hard to move!! This is why I hate wedding dresses! They don't suit me!」
「This pattern again. I like wedding dresses, but... I'm a little let down.」
Judging from appearances, the trio in wedding dresses must have been borrowing Juno's power, but it appeared that, since she was the goddess of June, she was out of season, so that power was lacking.
「Eeeegh... Feels kinda like it can't be done after all.」
She herself wasn't motivated in the first place.
「Nya nya nyaaa♪ It won't be long before the Year of the Cat, nyaaa♪」
Bastet was shaking her lucky cat body with pleasure.
「All I can do at this point is try my best to act like a miko. Bastet-sama, Bastet-sama, I beseech you～」
In the manner of a miko, Lilith began ringing bells while dancing with light steps.
I had thought that it was a mere cosplay outfit, but that dance was surprisingly expert, and had attracted Bastet's attention.
「Um, well. I beseech you. For all sorts of reasons, it would cause problems for this world to suddenly be in the Year of the Cat.」
「Couldn't you please go back and plop yourself down like the cute cat demon god you are? I beseech you, I beseech youuu～～」
「No, nyaa! The cats' resentment is just, nya!」
「We're going to take the place of the lying rat, and make the Year of the Cat a reality, nyaaaaa!」
The assembled cats also continued to make meows of protest.
The cats' resentment over having missed their chance to be in the zodiac was great.
Would we ultimately have to summon a rat god or something, and get him to negotiate for the Year of the Cat?
No, wait. Year of the Cat, was it?
Hadn't I'd heard of that somewhere before? Hmm, if I recalled rightly, it was―――
「Wait wait wait! You don't have to force it like that. There is a proper Year of the Cat!」
「It's Vietnam. Vietnam has a Year of the Cat. You just have to go to Vietnam!!」
「If you do that, you won't have to worry about the rats getting revenge on you for having their zodiac spot swiped, either!!」
「When? If I remember rightly, Vietnam's Year of the Cat is what we call the Year of the Rabbit in Japan, so, umm...... Three more years!」
「That's a pretty long way off, isn't it?」
「Is there anything we could use as an offering? She says she wants to become a god here. There must be something she has a weakness for.」
「Offering? There's no way I'd have anything like――― Ah!」
I rushed back at full speed to the place where I had been earlier, and fetched the two paper bags of kanpu-boshi.
「I beg you, Bastet!! Please return for now, with this as a gift!! This is top-grade, wind-dried Scandinavian salmon!」
「It's a feast, nyaa♪ I wouldn't mind going home, if this is what's on offer, nyaaa～～～♪ I'll come again in three years, nyaaaaaa～～～～～♪」
While purring, Bastet returned to its own world.
The cats here loudly protested to the cat demon god, who had been immediately enticed by the salmon, but it wasn't listening.
Well, that's what gods are like.
All of a sudden, voices resounded throughout the grounds.
It was the New Year's chant.
The frozen time had begun to move.
「Good grief. It's finally the New Year, huh?」
My form had also returned to normal.
「Unya? Why is Mer in a place like this, nya?」
「Nya nya nya? What's been happening, nya?」
The beastmen that Bastet had summoned were all looking puzzled.
It looked like they had been manipulated by the cat demon god. They were all cocking their heads in apparent confusion.
「Fuuma-san, don't tell me you brought that present because you foresaw this situation? That's precognition that would surprise even Obaa-sama!」
「Oh, is that so? But it was wonderful quick-wittedness, to persuade the demon god with that. You've saved us!!」
「No, it was all because that demon god was surprisingly weak to food.」
「It's just like Neu-san told me. This did make for a good experience as a witch. Thank you very much!」
Although I had been thanked by Lilith,
「What the hell is the meaning of this?」
「Suddenly getting sent to a place like this, and made to dress in these clothes...! Gimme a good explanation!」
The three in wedding dresses drew closer to me.
For whatever reason, their figures hadn't gone back to normal.
「This kind of thing happened before, too. Fuuma intended to marry me.」
「Dowaaaah!! What are you talking about, Anje?!」
「But this time there's three people. Are you going to choose one of us? Or all of us?」
「Huh? Huuuh?! Hey, wait! Pick one or all of us? Y-You didn't ask me anything!」
「Th-That's right. Don't decide things like that by yourself. If I don't like the explanation, I won't forgive you!」
「That's not true, not true!! I have no intention of that at all! Oi, Juno! You do the explaining!」
However, the figure of Juno was nowhere to be seen.
「She likes you a lot, I think.」
「Fuuma, what is the meaning of this?!」
The three of them were closing in on me.
「E-Even if you tell me to explain...... Hah!」
I got a bad feeling, and turned around.
Hebiko, Sakura, Yukikaze, Clear, and even Karasu were making scary faces.
「Fuuma-chan! With girls dressed like that again!!」
「What's more, three of them this time! You're unbelievable!!」
「Fuuma-kun, no matter what the reason is, you're getting too carried away, you know～～～?」
「「「「What the hell is the meaning of this?!!」」」」
I was surrounded by girls with oni-like expressions.
Even nearby Taimanin had started to talk.
This, right from the beginning of the year.
「Haah...... Looks like this year's gonna be a tough one too.」
「Oh dear, Fuuma-san. According to my divination, it looks like you have bad luck when it comes to women, don't you?」

「Ah, I forgot something important.
Everyone...
Happy New Year!」
